'''THAT'S IT!!!''' (Japanese: '''そうです!!!''' ''Soudesu!!!'') is the ending theme of [[PT10]].

The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on September 26, 2024.<ref>[https://lustqueen.info/news/20240925/ 新曲「そうです!!!」がポケモンアニメ「POKÉTOON」タイアップ決定＆デジタル配信開始！ | LustQueen]</ref>
